name: web-app
description: Linux App Service web app with Application Insights and Log Analytics. Dev runs a single Basic instance; prod runs a zone-redundant Premium v3 plan.
what: A Linux App Service web app running your code (.NET, Node, Python, etc.), with a system-assigned managed identity and built-in Application Insights + Log Analytics telemetry. Dev is a single Basic instance; prod is a zone-redundant Premium v3 plan.
why: App Service is the fastest way to host a web app or API on Azure without managing servers. Wiring identity, HTTPS hardening, health checks, and monitoring from the start means the same template carries a demo all the way to a resilient production footprint.
potentialUseCases: Hosting a company website, marketing site, or customer portal
A REST/GraphQL API backing a SPA or mobile app
A line-of-business app that needs HA without container/Kubernetes overhead
A demo or MVP you later scale to production by switching to the prod profile

reliability: Zone-redundant App Service plan (prod: P1v3, 3 instances across availability zones)
Platform health checks evict unhealthy instances (healthCheckPath)
Stateless app tier - scale out horizontally
security: Secrets belong in Key Vault referenced via managed identity
costOptimization: Dev uses Basic B1; prod uses Premium v3
Scale capacity to demand; consider reserved instances / savings plan for steady prod load
Application Insights sampling to cap ingestion cost
operationalExcellence: Centralized logs/metrics in Log Analytics + Application Insights
Infrastructure as Code with dev/prod parameter files
Health endpoint enables automated probes and alerts
performanceEfficiency: Premium v3 compute for prod throughput

components.name: App Service plan (P1v3 Linux) x3
components.notes: 3 instances x 730 hours for zone redundancy.
